subject: english
stem: The article argues that repair lessons are useful. Its example shows students fixing broken chair legs instead of discarding the chairs. What idea does the example support?
options: Repair skills can keep usable objects from becoming waste.
All chairs are easy to fix.

optionRationales.reason: Repair lessons teach only painting.：未提。
Repair skills can keep usable objects from becoming waste.：修椅取代丟棄直接支持實用與減廢。
All chairs are easy to fix.：all 過度。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「可爭論的主張由 because、since 或具體理由支撐，背景事實不一定是作者立場」可推出 Repair skills can keep usable objects from becoming waste.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Repair skills can keep usable objects from becoming waste. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
